title: Orchestration for embedding quality benchmarking and drift alerts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an orchestrated evaluation harness for embedding accuracy and ranking quality that supports: curated golden sets, large-scale offline metrics (MRR/NDCG/recall@k), daily drift detection, and runnable latency/throughput benches for the reranking endpoint. The harness should run in CI and as scheduled jobs in production to feed Console alerts and quality dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical golden sets ingested for at least 4 domains (search, KB QA, support tickets, product descriptions)
Daily batch job produces NDCG@10, MRR, recall@10, and median cosine similarity distributions and writes to metrics store
Drift detector produces signal >= P95 true positive rate on injected drift tests (simulated pivot + noise) before enabling alerts
Reranking latency microbench integrated: end-to-end median and 95th percentile token-serving latency measured for batched workloads and stored in Console
CI pipeline runs subset of golden tests on every embedding model upgrade and blocks release on >3% regression in NDCG@10 unless overridden with documented approval
implementation_notes: Architecture: scheduled Spark batch (EMR/Dataproc) computes offline ranking metrics against golden sets stored in S3 and writes metric snapshots to Prometheus/Influx + BigQuery daily table. A lightweight orchestrator (k8s cronjob) triggers both batch and a fast incremental drift job implemented in Beam that consumes sampled production embeddings from Kinesis. Drift detection: primary signal is median nearest-neighbor cosine shift and distributional two-sample KS on projected PCA components; secondary checks include embedding magnitude and per-class centroid drift. For scale, use GPU-accelerated PyTorch/FAISS for pairwise similarity when sample sizes < 50k; for larger samples use approximate indices (IVF+PQ) and stratified sampling. Reranking latency bench: harness replays real request traces (sanitized) with traffic-shaped concurrency to measure tail latencies and per-request tokenization + model runtime breakdowns. Integrations: Console alert rule templates, Dashboard (Grafana) panels, and linking to onboarding PRs. Trade-offs: KS test is sensitive but expensive at scale; we prioritize median-NN cosine which is cheaper but needs careful thresholding per domain. Plan to keep golden sets immutable with versioning and tag releases that evaluated against them.
test_plan: Unit tests for metric computations (NDCG/MRR/recall) with edge cases (empty candidate lists, ties)
Integration test: run batch job against synthetic dataset with known perturbations and assert drift detector fires
Performance test: run reranking bench at target QPS (200) and validate median latency < 120ms and p95 < 350ms on dedicated staging cluster
End-to-end: CI hook runs subset of golden tests for model PRs and blocks if regression threshold exceeded
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy harness components to staging and validate with archived traffic. 2) Run two-week shadow evaluation against production embeddings; collect baseline metrics. 3) Enable daily alerts at medium sensitivity for a pilot team (search). 4) Iterate thresholds and then enable org-wide alerts. 5) Add golden sets and domain configs for other teams incrementally.
rollback_plan: If alerts fire at unacceptable rates after rollout: 1) disable alerting rule for affected domain, 2) revert to previous metric snapshots retention policy, 3) revert any model gating automation and notify impacted teams; run forensic job to compare snapshots and determine root cause.

notes: Golden sets: keep per-domain labels, anonymize PII, include adversarial perturbations and near-duplicate examples. Plan to version goldens with semantic tags (v1-sanity, v1-adversarial). Consider experiment to run reranker in A/B using lightweight approximate embeddings to measure production impact before full model rollouts.
observability_integration: Alerting thresholds are configurable per-domain in Console. Metrics emitted: ndcg@10, mrr, recall@k, median_cosine_nn, ks_pvalue, sample_count, rerank_median_latency, rerank_p95_latency. Alerts post to #embeddings-quality Slack and create Incidents in PagerDuty only for high-confidence multi-signal drift (e.g., ndcg drop + median_cosine_nn shift)
estimated_cost_impact: Initial nightly pipeline estimated to cost ~$450/month in compute for daily 1M sample evaluation across 4 domains; adding GPUs for FAISS indexing raises cost to ~$1200/month but reduces wall time by 70%
